Rina (sales): POC kickoff with MeridianTech tomorrow. They insist on SSO-only access, SCIM sync, and an ephemeral CI service account. Also want billing separated and a short stress test on Dedicated without opening full admin access. Any quick guidance?
Alex (infra): We can make the workspace SSO-only and turn off static API keys. SCIM -> role mapping supported. For ephemeral CI accounts use a time-limited service account that only has `svc-inference`.
Priya (security): Minimal RBAC matrix: `svc-inference` (mint ephemeral tokens, call inference), `billing-view` (billing only), `viewer` (read-only), `model-uploader` (opt-in). No one gets `workspace-admin` except the POC owner. Recommend IP allowlist for token minting and disable model uploads unless requested.
Jordan (solutions): For the Dedicated stress test we can spin a 48-72h reserved pool. Need: GPU SKU, expected peak QPS, avg token size. We can recommend quantized model profile to save cost.
Mateo (acct exec): Billing separation: create `billing-view` scoped to invoices and usage. Trial billing for Dedicated: prorated short commit or hosted credits — we usually discuss specifics in email.
Rina (sales): Can someone paste a tiny invite JSON we can drop into their provisioning script?
Alex (infra): Sure - SCIM-friendly invite payload (expires in 7 days):
```json
{
  "email": "ci-bot@meridiantech.com",
  "display_name": "Meridian POC CI",
  "roles": ["svc-inference"],
  "scim_group": "meridian-poc",
  "expires_at": "2026-05-10T12:00:00Z"
}
```
Alex (infra): Ephemeral token mint CLI (1h TTL):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/workspaces/meridiantech/ephemeral_tokens" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"role":"svc-inference","ttl_seconds":3600}'
```
onboard-bot: Onboarding link: https://console.redwood.ai/onboard/meridiantech (valid 6 days) :link:
Rina (sales): Action items: Alex - send SCIM docs + invite snippet; Priya - draft security checklist for their questionnaire; Jordan - cost + Dedicated short-commit option; Mateo - follow up on billing separation email. I'll send the invite after we confirm mapping. :thumbsup:
